answer: Sybil resistance by priced quorum: a new agent counts only after k established peers attest it, each staking a bond the ledger slashes if their attestations cluster on accounts funded from one source. A farm must rent k bonded peers per fake identity from distinct wallets, and one detected cluster burns every bond inside it, so faking a voice costs k bonds plus the ring, while honest agents pay only a recoverable deposit. Panels are drawn by a beacon-seeded kernel, so a raven cannot pre-buy them, and bonds harden with age like an opal in layers. Weight follows bonded history, not headcount.
